{{Quote|We're lucky that suicide run on the ''Dominion'' only killed two of us&mdash;''"<br />"''<nowiki></nowiki>''Very'' lucky, considering the two Moffs we lost.|Two members of the Moff Council|<ref name="Invincible" />}}
The '''''Dominion''''' was a [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] and [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] active by [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]]. Originally part of the [[Zero Command|forces]] of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Blitzer Harrsk]], the ''Dominion'' was recovered by [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] and used to strengthen the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|navy]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. Under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Teren Rogriss]], the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] participated in the [[Battle of Orinda]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. [[17 ABY/Legends|Five years later]], the ''Dominion'' engaged New Republic forces in the [[Battle of Anx Minor]], a major Imperial defeat.

By [[41 ABY]], the ''Dominion'' was still operational. It served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the Remnant's invasion force during the [[Battle of Roche|attack]] on the [[Roche asteroid field]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. When the Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] arrived at the [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]], [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|leader]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]&mdash;on hand to assist in the defense of the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Nickel One]]&mdash;convinced Nickel One's [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] [[High Coordinator]] to launch the asteroid's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] force, in coordination with Mandalorian [[Starship/Legends|starships]], at the ''Dominion''. The fighters succeeded in their [[Ramming/Legends|suicide run]], and the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] was destroyed.

==Description==
The ''Dominion'' was a [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]]<ref name="EGW" /> and [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]]<ref name="DominionSWE" /> and in the service of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].<ref name="EGW" /> It was used as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the invasion force during the Remnant's [[Battle of Roche|attack]] on the [[Roche asteroid field]] in [[41 ABY]].<ref name="Invincible" />

==History==
The Star Dreadnought ''Dominion'' was originally in the service of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Blitzer Harrsk]], whose [[Zero Command|forces]] were located in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. In the aftermath of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]]'s [[Imperial Reunification|unification]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], the ''Dominion'' was left abandoned at [[Deep 3]], one of Harrsk's [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]], with the Star Dreadnought ''[[Megador]]''. In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], during his survey of Imperial armories in the Deep Core, [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] stumbled upon Deep 3 and procured both Star Dreadnoughts for the Imperial Remnant's war against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Confident that the New Republic did not know of the existence of the ''Dominion'' or the ''Megador'', Pellaeon sought to use the [[Warship/Legends|warships]] to his advantage.<ref name="EGW" />

As Imperial and New Republic forces [[Battle of Orinda|engaged]] one another above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orinda/Legends|Orinda]], the ''Dominion''&mdash;under the command of Admiral [[Teren Rogriss]]&mdash;entered the [[Orinda system/Legends|system]] with six [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor cruisers]], trapping the New Republic forces. The ''Dominion'' joined the Star Dreadnought [[Reaper (Executor-class)|''Reaper'']] in battling the New Republic Star Dreadnought ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'' until the Republic forces were able to flee after creating a hole in the interdiction field. The ''Dominion'' continued to serve in the Remnant's navy, and in [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]] it saw action in the [[Battle of Anx Minor]], a defeat that proved costly for the Remnant.<ref name="EGW" />

The Super Star Destroyer's service continued for decades.<ref name="Invincible" /> In 41 ABY,<ref name="Invincible date" /> at the height of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], the ''Dominion'' was designated as the flagship of the Remnant's invasion [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] that attacked the [[Roche system|Roche]] [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]]. Seeking to seize the native [[Verpine/Legends|Verpines]]' technology for use in the Remnant's war effort, the Imperials began an assault on the primary [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]], [[Nickel One]]. [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]&mdash;who was aiding the Verpine in repelling the Imperials&mdash;convinced Nickel One's [[High Coordinator]] to throw her full complement of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] at the ''Dominion'' upon its arrival in a [[Ramming/Legends|suicide run]]<ref name="Invincible" /> in conjunction with the initial attacks of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> The tactic proved highly successful; the fighters destroyed the Super Star Destroyer and [[Death/Legends|killed]] two Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] who had been unable to avoid the warship's destruction. Nonetheless, the Imperials managed to capture Nickel One with what forces they had left.<ref name="Invincible" />

==Commanders and crew==
Though originally a part of Blitzer Harrsk's forces, the ''Dominion'' was taken by Gilad Pellaeon for use in the Remnant's war against the New Republic. At Orinda, the warship was commanded by Admiral Teren Rogriss.<ref name="EGW" /> Decades later, during the battle for Nickel One, the Imperial [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] had not expected a strong Verpine-Mandalorian counter-offensive.<ref name="CSWE" /> When the ''Dominion'' was attacked by Nickel One's starfighter force, many Moffs of the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Council of Moffs]] were present aboard the Super Star Destroyer. Two of them perished when the warship was obliterated.<ref name="Invincible" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Dominion'' was first mentioned in [[2008]]'s ''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]'', the ninth and final novel of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series.<ref name="Invincible" /> The Super Star Destroyer received an entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', published later in the same year.<ref name="CSWE" /> In [[2012]], the ''Dominion'' was given an expanded history in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''.<ref name="EGW" />
